caveat: The page is a photograph of a curved book page, so the gutters are slightly
slanted and no axis-aligned rectangle is exact. Edges are read at the middle
of each gutter band. Both these labels and the model's output are axis-aligned
approximations of the same slanted truth, so a perfect IoU is not achievable
and around 0.9 is the practical ceiling.
Chosen because OCR read ZERO words on this page: no automated method can
produce ground truth here, which is exactly why it needs hand labels.
